firstPlayerRule: Everyone reveals a chosen card at the same time. The player who revealed the card with the lowest hit points goes first, then play goes clockwise.
internalEvidence: Fetched the Gamewright-hosted rules PDF listed on gamewright.com/rules and extracted its text with pdftotext. PDF page 4: "Then everyone reveals their chosen cards at the same time. The player who revealed the … card with the lowest hit points goes first by placing it face up in the center of the playing area. Going clockwise, each other player places their chosen card adjacent".
